# Cluster

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Group nearby points into map clusters for a zoom level (Supercluster).
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/cluster",
  "type": "ClusterOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/cluster').par.geojson` (an input) and `op('/cluster').out.featureCollection` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.geojson`, `out.featureCollection`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Remarks

Cluster uses [Supercluster](https://github.com/mapbox/supercluster). Each cluster is a point feature with `cluster: true`, `cluster_id`, `point_count`, `point_count_abbreviated` and `expansion_zoom`, the zoom at which the cluster splits apart. Points that are not in a cluster pass through with their own properties. Features that are not points are dropped.

Changing only `zoom` reuses the clustering index, so keyframing it with the camera zoom stays fast on large inputs.
